title: tack.yaml
description: Config for tack, a Go dependency-wiring generator. See https://github.com/benipranata/tack.

providers.description: Package directories (relative to the go.mod that owns this config) scanned for the global provider scope, shared by every configured interface unless shadowed by a local provider of the same type.

packages.description: Interfaces to generate wiring for, keyed by their own package directory.

additionalProperties.description: Interfaces to generate wiring for in this package directory, keyed by Go interface name. This directory is always scanned as a local provider scope too, unless localScan is set to false.

name.description: Constructor/struct name prefix, e.g. name: App -> NewAppIface.

output.description: Generated file name. Defaults to lower(name)_lower(interface)_gen.go.

localScan.description: Set to false to resolve this interface only from the global provider scope, skipping its own package directory as a local scope.
